title: On Crying for her mother all night
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：cry　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cry 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the researcher ① cried for her mother all night year after year, and every student in the lab said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three terms on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the researcher ② cries for her mother all night for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ cry for her mother all night at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ cried for her mother all night before — a line in the paper for February 1974 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Crying for her mother all night year after year, the researcher said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tube at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ cry the news down the whole street for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Cry the news down the whole street at once and never mention it again.

By 1987 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the paper, and a new student from the next lab ⑧ cries the news down the whole street year after year every term without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ cried for her mother all night again when nobody else would.

⑩ To cry for her mother all night, my mother said in 1992, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the lab remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the lab forgets, somebody cries for her mother all night for the whole place again and somebody must cry for her mother all night year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 哭喊（一般过去式 cried for her mother all night：1980 年研究员头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 哭喊（一般现在 cries for her mother all night：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 哭喊（不定式 to cry for her mother all night：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 哭喊（过去完成时 had cried for her mother all night：1974 年二月的研究报告上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 哭喊（动名词 crying for her mother all night 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 喊叫（cry the news down the whole street：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去喊叫把这消息喊遍整条街）
G. v. 喊叫（cry the news down the whole street：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 哭喊（后段两处：新来的学生照例 cries the news down the whole street，而母亲又一次 cried for her mother all night）

answers.why: cry 意为“哭喊”，1980 年研究员年年地哭喊整夜哭着喊娘，那是实验室里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 cried。
cry 意为“哭喊”，自那以后研究员替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 cries。
cry 意为“哭喊”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯哭喊整夜哭着喊娘”，此处为不定式 to cry for her mother all night。
cry 意为“哭喊”，研究报告里 二月 那行字说明早在 1987 年之前就有人哭喊过，故用过去完成时 had cried。
cry 意为“哭喊”，研究员说“哭喊整夜哭着喊娘这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 crying for her mother all night 作主语。
cry 意为“喊叫”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去喊叫把这消息喊遍整条街”，should ever 之后用原形 cry the news down the whole street。
cry 意为“喊叫”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻喊叫把这消息喊遍整条街（cry the news down the whole street at once），以后再也不要提起。
cry 意为“哭喊”，新来的学生每个学期都照例喊叫把这消息喊遍整条街，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 cries。
cry 意为“哭喊”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地哭喊整夜哭着喊娘，用一般过去式 cried 叙述。
cry 意为“哭喊”，结尾那句是母亲 1992 年的话：要哭喊整夜哭着喊娘，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和实验室记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。

多年以后，研究员仍替所有人做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（cries for her mother all night）

研究员说过，年年地哭喊整夜哭着喊娘这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（crying for her mother all night 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻喊叫把这消息喊遍整条街，以后再也不要提起。（cry the news down the whole street，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 cry 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1980 the researcher cried for her mother all night year after year, and nobody in the lab forgot it.
Even now the researcher cries for her mother all night for the whole place whenever the lab asks.
Crying for her mother all night year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever cry the news down the whole street for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new student from the next lab cries the news down the whole street year after year every term, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother cried for her mother all night again, and the lab remembered that half.
